mapper.select: SELECT post_id, user_id, post_title, post_content, post_date, post_count, post_like_count, target_type AS targetType, target_id AS targetId FROM post WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY post_id DESC
SELECT post_id, user_id, post_title, post_content, post_date, post_count, post_like_count, target_type AS targetType, target_id AS targetId FROM post WHERE post_id = #{post_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post ( user_id, post_title, post_content, post_date, post_count, post_like_count, target_type, target_id ) VALUES ( #{user_id}, #{post_title}, #{post_content}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0, 0, #{targetType}, #{targetId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET post_title = #{post_title}, post_content = #{post_content}, target_type = #{targetType}, target_id = #{targetId} WHERE post_id = #{post_id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE target_type = #{targetType}
